```{=html}
<div class="arha-globe">
  <div class="globe-stage">
    <canvas id="arha-globe-canvas" tabindex="0" role="img"
            aria-label="Globe of Project ArHa host sampling records, binned into hexagons. Loading."></canvas>
    <div class="globe-tooltip" hidden></div>
  </div>
  <div class="globe-side">
    <p class="globe-legend-title">Host sampling records per hexagon</p>
    <ul class="globe-legend" id="arha-globe-legend"></ul>
    <p id="arha-globe-caption">Loading the sampling record.</p>
    <p>Drag to rotate, or focus the globe and use the arrow keys. The records themselves are in the <a href="https://diddrog11.shinyapps.io/ArHa_Database_Explorer/">ArHa database explorer</a>.</p>
    <details class="globe-table">
      <summary>Show as a table</summary>
      <table class="table table-sm">
        <caption id="arha-globe-table-caption">Host sampling records by country.</caption>
        <thead><tr><th scope="col">Country</th><th scope="col">Records</th><th scope="col">Locations</th><th scope="col">Individuals</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody id="arha-globe-table-body"></tbody>
      </table>
    </details>
  </div>
</div>

<script src="/assets/js/d3.v7.9.0.min.js"></script>
<script>
(() => {
  // Data are built by scripts/build_globe_data.R into assets/data/. Nothing
  // here fetches from a third party; d3 is self-hosted under assets/js/.
  const canvas = document.getElementById("arha-globe-canvas");
  if (!canvas || !window.d3) return;
  const stage = canvas.parentElement;
  const tip = stage.querySelector(".globe-tooltip");
  const legend = document.getElementById("arha-globe-legend");
  const caption = document.getElementById("arha-globe-caption");

  // Records per cell are heavily skewed (median ~15, max ~16,000), so the
  // ramp uses round, roughly logarithmic breaks rather than a linear scale.
  const breaks = [5, 20, 100, 500];
  const labels = ["1 to 4", "5 to 19", "20 to 99", "100 to 499", "500 or more"];
  const classOf = n => { const i = breaks.findIndex(b => n < b); return i === -1 ? breaks.length : i; };
  const cellArea = { 1: "609,000", 2: "86,700", 3: "12,400", 4: "1,770" };
  const fmt = d3.format(",");
  const plural = (n, one, many) => `${fmt(n)} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`;

  // Colours come from the theme's custom properties, so light and dark
  // follow the site toggle without duplicating values in script.
  const token = name => getComputedStyle(document.body).getPropertyValue(name).trim();
  let colours = {};
  const readColours = () => {
    colours = {
      sea: token("--globe-sea"), land: token("--globe-land"), gap: token("--ds-ground"),
      line: token("--ds-hero-line"), ink: token("--ds-ink"),
      seq: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(i => token(`--seq-${i}`))
    };
  };

  readColours();

  // Opens centred on Africa, where the gaps in coverage are widest.
  const projection = d3.geoOrthographic().rotate([-20, -5]).clipAngle(90).precision(0.3);
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const path = d3.geoPath(projection, ctx);
  const sphere = { type: "Sphere" };
  const graticule = d3.geoGraticule10();
  let land = null, cells = [], hovered = null, size = 0;

  // d3-geo reads a ring enclosing more than a hemisphere as the complement
  // of the shape, so any polygon that comes out that way is reversed.
  const reverseRings = g => {
    if (g.type === "Polygon") g.coordinates = g.coordinates.map(r => r.slice().reverse());
    if (g.type === "MultiPolygon") g.coordinates = g.coordinates.map(p => p.map(r => r.slice().reverse()));
  };
  const fixWinding = f => { if (d3.geoArea(f) > 2 * Math.PI) reverseRings(f.geometry); return f; };

  const draw = () => {
    if (!size) return;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, size, size);
    ctx.beginPath(); path(sphere); ctx.fillStyle = colours.sea; ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); path(graticule); ctx.strokeStyle = colours.line; ctx.lineWidth = 0.5; ctx.stroke();
    if (land) { ctx.beginPath(); path(land); ctx.fillStyle = colours.land; ctx.fill(); }
    colours.seq.forEach((fill, k) => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (const c of cells) if (c.k === k) path(c);
      ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill();
    });
    ctx.beginPath(); for (const c of cells) path(c);
    ctx.strokeStyle = colours.gap; ctx.lineWidth = 0.6; ctx.stroke();
    if (hovered) { ctx.beginPath(); path(hovered); ctx.strokeStyle = colours.ink; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.stroke(); }
    ctx.beginPath(); path(sphere); ctx.strokeStyle = colours.line; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke();
  };

  const resize = () => {
    size = stage.clientWidth;
    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = Math.round(size * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(size * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    projection.translate([size / 2, size / 2]).scale(size / 2 - 2);
    draw();
  };

  const hideTip = () => { tip.hidden = true; if (hovered) { hovered = null; draw(); } };
  const showTip = (c, x, y) => {
    const { r, i, s } = c.properties;
    tip.replaceChildren();
    const head = document.createElement("strong");
    head.textContent = plural(r, "record", "records");
    tip.append(head, document.createTextNode(plural(i, "individual", "individuals")),
               document.createElement("br"), document.createTextNode(plural(s, "species", "species")));
    tip.style.left = `${x}px`; tip.style.top = `${y}px`; tip.hidden = false;
  };

  const rotateBy = (dLon, dLat) => {
    const [lon, lat] = projection.rotate();
    projection.rotate([lon + dLon, Math.max(-90, Math.min(90, lat + dLat))]);
    draw();
  };

  d3.select(canvas).call(d3.drag().on("start", hideTip).on("drag", e => {
    const k = 75 / projection.scale();
    rotateBy(e.dx * k, -e.dy * k);
  }));

  canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
    if (!cells.length) return;
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left, y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const dx = x - size / 2, dy = y - size / 2;
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy > (size / 2) ** 2) return hideTip();
    const ll = projection.invert([x, y]);
    const hit = cells.find(c => d3.geoContains(c, ll)) || null;
    if (!hit) return hideTip();
    if (hit !== hovered) { hovered = hit; draw(); }
    showTip(hit, x, y);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerleave", hideTip);

  canvas.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
    const step = { ArrowLeft: [10, 0], ArrowRight: [-10, 0], ArrowUp: [0, -10], ArrowDown: [0, 10] }[e.key];
    if (!step) return;
    e.preventDefault(); hideTip(); rotateBy(...step);
  });

  // Quarto switches light and dark by swapping a class on <body>.
  new MutationObserver(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => { readColours(); draw(); }))
    .observe(document.body, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"] });
  new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(stage);

  labels.forEach((text, k) => {
    const li = document.createElement("li");
    const sw = document.createElement("span");
    sw.className = "swatch";
    sw.style.background = `var(--seq-${k + 1})`;
    li.append(sw, document.createTextNode(text));
    legend.append(li);
  });

  Promise.all([d3.json("/assets/data/land_110m.json"), d3.json("/assets/data/arha_host_hex.json")])
    .then(([l, h]) => {
      l.features.forEach(fixWinding);
      land = l;
      cells = h.cells.map(([r, i, s, b]) => {
        const ring = [];
        for (let j = 0; j < b.length; j += 2) ring.push([b[j], b[j + 1]]);
        const f = fixWinding({ type: "Feature", properties: { r, i, s }, geometry: { type: "Polygon", coordinates: [ring] } });
        f.k = classOf(r);
        return f;
      });
      const m = h.meta;
      const area = cellArea[m.h3_resolution] ? ` of about ${cellArea[m.h3_resolution]} km² each` : "";
      caption.textContent = `${fmt(m.n_records)} host sampling records from ${fmt(m.n_locations)} locations in ${m.n_countries} countries, grouped into ${fmt(m.n_cells)} hexagons${area}. Empty and pale regions show where small mammals have rarely been sampled for these viruses, not where the viruses are absent. Project ArHa data, ${m.source_modified}.`;
      canvas.setAttribute("aria-label", `Globe of Project ArHa host sampling records. ${caption.textContent}`);

      readColours();
      resize();

      // Table view: the same records by country, so no value is reachable
      // only by hovering. Built after the globe has drawn, and guarded, so a
      // problem here can never stop the globe. Quarto rewrites HTML tables and
      // drops ids on <caption>, so the caption is found through the table.
      try {
        const tbody = document.getElementById("arha-globe-table-body");
        for (const [country, records, locations, individuals] of (h.countries || [])) {
          const tr = document.createElement("tr");
          for (const v of [country, fmt(records), fmt(locations), fmt(individuals)]) {
            const td = document.createElement("td");
            td.textContent = v;
            tr.append(td);
          }
          tbody.append(tr);
        }
        const tableCaption = tbody.closest("table")?.querySelector("caption");
        if (tableCaption && m.n_records_no_country) {
          tableCaption.textContent = `Host sampling records by country. ${fmt(m.n_records_no_country)} records with coordinates but no country code are not shown.`;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("Globe table view could not be built", e);
      }
    })
    .catch(() => { caption.textContent = "The globe could not load its data."; });
})();
</script>
```
